question:
Which of the following professions is a type of seasonal unemployment?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Doctors
Information Technology professional
Accountants
Farmer
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Farmer

Explanation:
Seasonal unemployment occurs when individuals are unable to find jobs during certain periods of the year due to the seasonal nature of their work. Farmers are the best example of this because agricultural activities like sowing, irrigation, and harvesting are limited to specific seasons. During the off-season, farmers often face unemployment. Other options like doctors, IT professionals, and accountants typically have year-round employment, so they do not represent seasonal unemployment.

Extra Facts:
Seasonal unemployment is common in industries like agriculture, tourism, and construction, where work depends on weather or demand cycles. Governments implement schemes like MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act) to provide alternative employment during off-seasons. Diversification into allied sectors like dairy farming or fisheries can also reduce seasonal unemployment. This type of unemployment is temporary but recurrent, requiring targeted policies for mitigation.

question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पेशा मौसमी बेरोज़गारी का एक प्रकार है?

[SSC MTS 2022]
options_hi: चिकित्सक
सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी पेशेवर (Information Technology professional)
लेखाकार (Accountants)
किसान
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है किसान

Explanation:
मौसमी बेरोज़गारी वह स्थिति है जब किसी व्यक्ति को वर्ष के कुछ विशेष मौसमों में ही रोज़गार मिलता है और शेष समय में वह बेरोज़गार रहता है। किसान इसका सबसे अच्छा उदाहरण है क्योंकि कृषि कार्य मुख्य रूप से बुआई, सिंचाई और कटाई के मौसम तक ही सीमित होते हैं। बाकी समय में किसानों के पास काम नहीं होता, जिससे वे मौसमी बेरोज़गारी का शिकार हो जाते हैं। अन्य विकल्प जैसे चिकित्सक, आईटी पेशेवर और लेखाकार आमतौर पर पूरे वर्ष नौकरी करते हैं, इसलिए ये मौसमी बेरोज़गारी के उदाहरण नहीं हैं।

Extra Facts:
मौसमी बेरोज़गारी आमतौर पर कृषि, पर्यटन और निर्माण जैसे उद्योगों में देखी जाती है। यह अर्थव्यवस्था में अस्थायी और चक्रीय प्रकृति की होती है। इस प्रकार की बेरोज़गारी को कम करने के लिए सरकारें कई योजनाएं चलाती हैं, जैसे मनरेगा (MGNREGA), जो ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में रोज़गार सुनिश्चित करती है। इसके अलावा, किसानों को वैकल्पिक आय के स्रोत जैसे डेयरी फार्मिंग, मत्स्य पालन आदि अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है।

question:
In India, who introduced the idea of the poverty line for the first time?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: Dadabhai Naoroji
Dr. BR Ambedkar
Mahatma Gandhi
Jawaharlal Nehru
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dadabhai Naoroji

Explanation:
The concept of the poverty line in India was first introduced by Dadabhai Naoroji in his book 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' (1876). He proposed this idea to measure poverty and highlight the economic exploitation under British colonial rule. Naoroji's work laid the foundation for later poverty estimation methods in India. His approach emphasized the need for a minimum income threshold to meet basic needs, which later evolved into the modern poverty line concept used in policy-making.

Extra Facts:
The poverty line represents the minimum income required to afford basic necessities like food, shelter, and clothing. In India, the Tendulkar Committee (2009) and Rangarajan Committee (2014) refined its calculation. Poverty line data is crucial for welfare schemes like MGNREGA and the Public Distribution System (PDS). The concept remains central to India's socio-economic planning.

☛ First committee to estimate poverty in India? → Alagh Committee
question_hi:
भारत में गरीबी रेखा का विचार पहली बार किसने दिया?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options_hi: दादाभाई नौरोजी
डॉ. बी. आर. अम्बेडकर
महात्मा गांधी
जवाहर लाल नेहरू
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है दादाभाई नौरोजी

Explanation:
भारत में गरीबी रेखा का विचार सबसे पहले दादाभाई नौरोजी ने दिया था। उन्होंने अपनी पुस्तक 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' (1876) में इस अवधारणा को प्रस्तुत किया। नौरोजी ने गरीबी को मापने के लिए एक मानक तय किया, जिसे बाद में 'गरीबी रेखा' कहा गया। उन्होंने यह विचार भारत में ब्रिटिश शासन के दौरान आर्थिक शोषण और गरीबी के प्रभावों को समझने के लिए प्रस्तुत किया। यह अवधारणा आज भी भारत की आर्थिक नीतियों और योजनाओं में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है।

Extra Facts:
गरीबी रेखा एक न्यूनतम आय स्तर है, जिसके नीचे व्यक्ति अपनी बुनियादी जरूरतों को पूरा नहीं कर पाता। भारत में वर्तमान में टेंडुलकर समिति (2009) और रंगराजन समिति (2014) द्वारा गरीबी रेखा को परिभाषित किया गया है। गरीबी रेखा का उपयोग सरकारी योजनाओं जैसे मनरेगा, पीडीएस आदि के लाभार्थियों की पहचान में किया जाता है।

question:
According to the National Crime Records Bureau data, from 2016 to 2019, suicide cases due to unemployment have increased by ______.

[SSC CHSL 2024]
options: 24%
20%
18%
21%
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 24%

Explanation:
According to the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) data from 2016 to 2019, suicide cases due to unemployment have increased by 24%. This highlights factors such as economic distress and lack of employment opportunities. Unemployment is a severe economic issue that negatively impacts not only individuals but also society and the economy. These statistics underscore the need for economic policies and employment generation programs.

Extra Facts:
There is a clear correlation between unemployment rates and suicide cases. Economic instability and job uncertainty affect mental health. In India, the unemployment rate among youth is particularly high, which is a major reason for the rise in suicide cases. The government needs to implement effective economic policies and employment generation programs to address this issue.

question:
According to the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO), the unemployment rate for people aged 15 years and above in urban areas declined to ____ percent during January-March 2023, from 8.2 percent a year ago.

[SSC GD 2024]
options: 5.1%
9.2%
6.8%
2.4%
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 6.8%

Explanation:
According to the National Sample Survey Office (NSSO), the unemployment rate for people aged 15 years and above in urban areas declined to 6.8% during January-March 2023, down from 8.2% a year ago. This data reflects an improvement in urban unemployment in India. The unemployment rate is calculated as the percentage of unemployed individuals in the labor force. It is a key indicator of economic growth, job creation, and labor market conditions.

Extra Facts:
The NSSO operates under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, Government of India. It collects data on employment, unemployment, consumer expenditure, and other socio-economic parameters. A decline in the unemployment rate signals increased economic activity, job creation, and labor market improvements.

question:
Which of the following options is the most appropriate cause for unemployment in India?

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: Over population
Environment conditions
High educational systems
Lack of labour force
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Over population

Explanation:
The most appropriate cause of unemployment in India is overpopulation. India's population is growing rapidly, while employment opportunities remain limited. This creates an imbalance between demand and supply, where the number of job seekers exceeds the available jobs. Additionally, slow economic growth, lack of skilled labor, and sluggish industrialization further contribute to unemployment.

Extra Facts:
Structural unemployment is a major issue in India, where there is a mismatch between workforce skills and job requirements. Seasonal unemployment is observed in the agricultural sector, where work is available only during specific seasons. The government has introduced schemes like MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act) to promote employment generation in rural areas.

भारत में बेरोजगारी का प्रमुख कारण अत्यधिक जनसंख्या है। भारत की जनसंख्या तेजी से बढ़ रही है, जबकि रोजगार के अवसर सीमित हैं। यह मांग और आपूर्ति का असंतुलन पैदा करता है, जहां नौकरियों की संख्या की तुलना में नौकरी चाहने वालों की संख्या अधिक हो जाती है। इसके अलावा, आर्थिक विकास की धीमी गति, कुशल श्रम की कमी, और औद्योगीकरण की धीमी प्रक्रिया भी बेरोजगारी को बढ़ावा देते हैं।

Extra Facts:
संरचनात्मक बेरोजगारी भारत में एक प्रमुख समस्या है, जहां श्रम शक्ति की कौशल और नौकरी की आवश्यकताओं के बीच असंतुलन होता है। मौसमी बेरोजगारी कृषि क्षेत्र में देखी जाती है, जहां काम केवल विशेष मौसम में ही उपलब्ध होता है। सरकार ने मनरेगा (MGNREGA) जैसी योजनाएं शुरू की हैं, जो ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में रोजगार सृजन को बढ़ावा देती हैं।

question:
_________unemployment refers to the lowest unemployment level a healthy economy can sustain without causing inflation.

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: Structural
Disguised
Natural
Frictional
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Natural

Explanation:
Natural Unemployment refers to the minimum unemployment level that a healthy economy can sustain without causing inflation. It is the sum of structural and frictional unemployment. Natural unemployment represents the normal functioning of the economy and is also called the Natural Rate of Unemployment (NRU). It occurs due to factors like technological changes, labor market inefficiencies, and time taken to find new jobs. This rate signifies the economy's full employment level, where all available labor resources are used efficiently without inflationary pressure.

Extra Facts:
The concept of natural unemployment was developed by economists Milton Friedman and Edmund Phelps. It is linked to the Phillips Curve, which shows an inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment. Natural unemployment includes frictional unemployment (time taken to switch jobs) and structural unemployment (skill-job mismatch), but excludes cyclical unemployment (caused by recessions). Governments aim to keep unemployment close to NRU to avoid inflation or recession.

☛ Unemployment during job transitions is called? → Frictional Unemployment
☛ What does the Phillips Curve illustrate? → Inflation-Unemployment trade-off
☛ Which unemployment becomes zero at full employment? → Cyclical Unemployment

_________ बेरोज़गारी उस न्यूनतम बेरोज़गारी स्तर को कहते हैं, जिसे एक स्वस्थ अर्थव्यवस्था, मुद्रास्फीति पैदा किए बिना बनाए रख सकती है।

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है प्राकृतिक

Explanation:
प्राकृतिक बेरोज़गारी (Natural Unemployment) वह न्यूनतम बेरोज़गारी स्तर है जिसे एक स्वस्थ अर्थव्यवस्था मुद्रास्फीति पैदा किए बिना बनाए रख सकती है। यह बेरोज़गारी संरचनात्मक और प्रतिरोधात्मक बेरोज़गारी का योग होती है। प्राकृतिक बेरोज़गारी अर्थव्यवस्था की सामान्य स्थिति को दर्शाती है और इसे 'बेरोज़गारी की प्राकृतिक दर' (Natural Rate of Unemployment - NRU) भी कहा जाता है। यह अर्थव्यवस्था में मौजूदा तकनीकी, श्रम बाजार की अकुशलताओं और नौकरी खोजने में लगने वाले समय जैसे कारकों के कारण होती है। यह दर अर्थव्यवस्था की 'पूर्ण रोजगार' (Full Employment) स्थिति को भी दर्शाती है।

Extra Facts:
प्राकृतिक बेरोज़गारी की अवधारणा अर्थशास्त्री मिल्टन फ्रीडमैन और एडमंड फेल्प्स द्वारा विकसित की गई थी। यह अवधारणा फिलिप्स वक्र (Phillips Curve) से जुड़ी है, जो मुद्रास्फीति और बेरोज़गारी के बीच व्युत्क्रम संबंध दिखाती है। प्राकृतिक बेरोज़गारी में प्रतिरोधात्मक बेरोज़गारी (नौकरी बदलने में लगने वाला समय) और संरचनात्मक बेरोज़गारी (कौशल और नौकरी की मांग में असंतुलन) शामिल होती है, लेकिन चक्रीय बेरोज़गारी (मंदी के कारण) इसमें शामिल नहीं होती।

question:
In 2009-10, the Poverty line was defined for rural areas as consumption worth ₹673 per person_______and for urban areas it was ₹860.

[NTPC CBT 2]
options: half-yearly
monthly
quarterly
yearly
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is monthly

Explanation:
In 2009-10, the 'Tendulkar Committee' recommendations defined the poverty line in India. For rural areas, it was ₹673 per person per month, and for urban areas, it was ₹860 per person per month. This criterion was based on consumption expenditure, including basic necessities like food, clothing, housing, education, and healthcare. The poverty line calculation considered calorie intake and standard of living.

Extra Facts:
The Tendulkar Committee updated the 1973-74 Alagh Committee benchmarks. In 2011-12, the Rangarajan Committee suggested new standards: ₹972 (rural) and ₹1,407 (urban) per person per month. India also uses the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) to measure poverty, which evaluates health, education, and living standards.

Explanation:

Extra Facts:
गरीबी रेखा की गणना में तेंदुलकर समिति ने 1973-74 के अलघ समिति के मापदंडों को अपडेट किया था। 2011-12 में रंगराजन समिति ने ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों के लिए ₹972 और शहरी क्षेत्रों के लिए ₹1,407 प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति माह का नया मानक सुझाया। भारत में गरीबी मापने के लिए बहुआयामी गरीबी सूचकांक (MPI) भी उपयोग किया जाता है, जो स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा और जीवन स्तर के विभिन्न पहलुओं को मापता है।

question:
Which of the following is a difference between self-help groups (SHGs) and microfinance institutions (MFIs) in India?

[SSC CGL 2024]
options: SHGs are non-profit organisations, while MFIs are for-profit organisations
SHGs provide only credit, while MFIs provide a range of financial services.
SHGs are typically small, community-based organisations, while MFIs are larger and more formal institutions.
SHGs rely on government subsidies for funding, while MFIs rely on commercial sources of funding.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is SHGs are typically small, community-based organisations, while MFIs are larger and more formal institutions.

Explanation:
Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) both promote financial inclusion but differ in their structure and functioning. SHGs are small, community-based organisations that operate at the grassroots level to empower the poor, especially women. These groups are usually informal and facilitate savings and credit among members. On the other hand, MFIs are larger and more formal institutions that provide microcredit and other financial services. These institutions are often registered and operate in a commercial manner.

Extra Facts:
Both SHGs and MFIs are crucial tools for poverty alleviation and economic empowerment in India. The primary objective of SHGs is collective savings and social security, while MFIs focus on providing profit-oriented financial services. SHGs can avail loans under the Bank Linkage Programme (BLP), whereas MFIs raise funds from private investors or commercial banks. SHG membership is limited and local, while MFIs have a broader reach.

☛ What is the full form of MFI? → Microfinance Institution
☛ In which year was the SHG Bank Linkage Programme launched? → 1992
☛ Who regulates microfinance in India? → RBI
☛ What is the usual membership size of an SHG? → 10-20 members

स्वयं सहायता समूह (SHG) और सूक्ष्म वित्त संस्थान (MFI) दोनों ही वित्तीय समावेशन को बढ़ावा देते हैं, लेकिन इनकी संरचना और कार्यप्रणाली में अंतर होता है। SHG छोटे, समुदाय-आधारित संगठन होते हैं जो स्थानीय स्तर पर गरीबों, विशेषकर महिलाओं, को सशक्त बनाने के लिए काम करते हैं। ये समूह आमतौर पर अनौपचारिक होते हैं और सदस्यों के बीच बचत और ऋण की सुविधा प्रदान करते हैं। दूसरी ओर, MFI बड़े और औपचारिक संस्थान होते हैं जो सूक्ष्म ऋण और अन्य वित्तीय सेवाएं प्रदान करते हैं। ये संस्थाएं अक्सर पंजीकृत होती हैं और इनका संचालन व्यावसायिक तरीके से किया जाता है।

question:

options: Lend
Linkage
Link
Lending

Explanation:
SHG-BLP stands for 'Self Help Group - Bank Linkage Programme', a key microfinance model in India initiated by NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) in 1992. Here, 'L' refers to 'Linkage', representing the connection between banks and Self Help Groups (SHGs). The program aims to promote financial inclusion by providing rural and underprivileged communities access to banking services. It plays a vital role in disbursing microcredit to empower small entrepreneurs, especially women, fostering grassroots economic development.

Extra Facts:
1. Under SHG-BLP, groups receive direct loans from banks to start micro-enterprises.
2. It significantly contributes to women's empowerment, as most SHGs are female-led.
3. NABARD reports that the program has generated employment in sectors like agriculture, dairy, and handicrafts.
4. The three-tier model involves: SHGs → Banks → NABARD/Government.

SHG-BLP का पूरा नाम 'Self Help Group - Bank Linkage Programme' है। यह भारत में सूक्ष्म वित्त (microfinance) का एक महत्वपूर्ण मॉडल है, जिसे NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) द्वारा 1992 में शुरू किया गया था। इसमें 'L' का अर्थ 'Linkage' (लिंकेज) होता है, जो बैंकों और स्वयं सहायता समूहों (SHGs) के बीच संबंध स्थापित करने की प्रक्रिया को दर्शाता है। इस कार्यक्रम का मुख्य उद्देश्य ग्रामीण और गरीब लोगों को बैंकिंग सुविधाओं से जोड़कर उनकी वित्तीय समावेशन (financial inclusion) को बढ़ावा देना है। यह मॉडल सूक्ष्म ऋण (microcredit) प्रदान करने में अहम भूमिका निभाता है।

Extra Facts:
1. SHG-BLP के तहत, समूहों को बैंकों से सीधे ऋण मिलता है, जिससे वे छोटे व्यवसाय शुरू कर सकते हैं।
2. यह कार्यक्रम महिला सशक्तिकरण को भी बढ़ावा देता है, क्योंकि अधिकांश SHGs महिलाओं द्वारा चलाए जाते हैं।
3. NABARD के अनुसार, इस कार्यक्रम ने कृषि, पशुपालन और हस्तशिल्प जैसे क्षेत्रों में रोजगार सृजन किया है।
4. SHG-BLP का तीन-स्तरीय मॉडल है: SHG → बैंक → NABARD/सरकार।

question:
According to the 2014 Rangarajan Committee regarding national poverty lines in India, which of the following statements is correct?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: A person who has a monthly per capita consumption expenditure of less than Rs. 1,272, living in the rural areas should be considered poor.
A person who has a monthly per capita consumption expenditure of less than Rs. 2,407, living in the urban areas should be considered poor.
A person who has a monthly per capita consumption expenditure of less than Rs. 872, living in the rural areas should be considered poor.
A person who has a monthly per capita consumption expenditure of less than Rs. 1,407, living in the urban areas should be considered poor.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is A person who has a monthly per capita consumption expenditure of less than Rs. 2,407, living in the urban areas should be considered poor.

Explanation:
The Rangarajan Committee (2014) redefined poverty lines in India using a more comprehensive methodology. It recommended that a person spending less than ₹972 per month in rural areas or ₹1,407 in urban areas (at 2011-12 prices) should be considered poor. This was based on calorie requirements, education, health, and other basic amenities, making it broader than the earlier Tendulkar Committee (2009) thresholds of ₹816 (rural) and ₹1,000 (urban). The committee also introduced a separate higher threshold (₹2,407 urban) for those barely above the poverty line.

Extra Facts:
India’s poverty estimation has evolved through committees like Alagh (1979, calorie-based), Tendulkar (2009, inclusion of health/education), and Rangarajan (2014, multi-dimensional approach). However, the government currently uses Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 for welfare schemes. The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) by UNDP measures poverty beyond income, covering health, education, and living standards.

question:
If people cannot be used as a resource they naturally appear as _____ to the economy.

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: a liability
an asset
indispensable
important
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is a liability

Explanation:
If people cannot be used as a resource, they naturally appear as a 'liability' to the economy. This is because they require investments in education, healthcare, and other basic necessities, which impose an economic burden on the government and society. In economics, 'resources' are factors that contribute to the production process, such as labor, capital, and land. If human resources remain unutilized, they do not contribute to productivity and thus become a 'liability'.

Extra Facts:
Human resources are the backbone of an economy. Without proper training and employment opportunities, they lead to unemployment and poverty, negatively impacting economic growth. Human capital formation transforms people into productive resources through education, healthcare, and skill development. Countries with high human capital experience faster development.

question:
From the given options, select the one that correctly describes the meaning of ‘Head Count Ratio’.

[NTPC CBT 2]
options:
When the number of rich is estimated as the proportion of people on par with the
poverty line

When the number of people with average income is estimated as the proportion of
people on par with the poverty line
When the number of poor is estimated as the proportion of people above the poverty line
When the number of poor is estimated as the proportion of people below the poverty line
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is When the number of poor is estimated as the proportion of people below the poverty line

Explanation:
The 'Head Count Ratio' is a key indicator used to measure poverty. It calculates the proportion of a population living below the poverty line by dividing the number of poor people by the total population. This ratio is expressed as a percentage. For example, if 20 out of 100 people in a country live below the poverty line, the Head Count Ratio would be 20%. While this index helps understand the extent of poverty, it does not reflect the depth (Poverty Gap) or severity (Severity of Poverty) of poverty.

Extra Facts:
Other important poverty measures include the 'Poverty Gap Index' and the 'Squared Poverty Gap Index'. The Poverty Gap Index measures the average shortfall of income of the poor from the poverty line, while the Squared Poverty Gap Index indicates the severity of poverty. These indices help policymakers design targeted welfare schemes by providing a deeper understanding of poverty dimensions.

question:
In the context of microfinance, what does ‘S’ stand for in SHG?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: Social
Steady
Sustainable
Self
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Self

Explanation:
In the context of microfinance, SHG stands for 'Self Help Group'. It is a group formed to empower economically weaker sections, especially women, by encouraging them to pool their savings and provide small loans through mutual consensus. The 'Self' in SHG emphasizes the concept of self-reliance, where members use their own resources rather than depending on external aid. This model promotes economic empowerment and social solidarity among members.

Extra Facts:
Self Help Groups (SHGs) are a key tool for rural development and women's empowerment in India. They are part of microfinance, which includes small loans, savings, and insurance services. The primary goal of SHGs is to achieve economic self-sufficiency and social transformation. Typically, an SHG consists of 10-20 members who hold regular meetings and make collective decisions. SHGs often link with formal financial institutions through the Bank Linkage Program, initiated by NABARD in 1992.

question:
Until 1993-94, the estimation of poverty line in India was based on URP data. What is the full form of 'URP' ?

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Uniform Research Period
Usual Reference Period
Uniform Reference Period
Usual Research Period
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Uniform Reference Period

Explanation:
In India, until 1993-94, the poverty line estimation was based on 'Uniform Reference Period (URP)' data. This method assessed consumption expenditure over 'a uniform 30-day period' for all items. The aim was to use a standardized time frame for measuring poverty levels. Later, it was replaced by the 'Mixed Reference Period (MRP)' and then the 'Modified Mixed Reference Period (MMRP)', which used different reference periods for different items. URP was used to ensure 'time consistency' and 'comparability' in poverty assessment.

Extra Facts:
In India, various committees like the 'Tendulkar Committee' and 'Rangarajan Committee' have suggested different criteria for poverty line estimation. Apart from URP, 'MRP' uses a 365-day reference period. The poverty line is determined based on 'calorie intake' and 'availability of essential commodities'. It is a crucial indicator for economic planning and social welfare schemes.

भारत में 1993-94 तक गरीबी रेखा का आकलन 'यूनिफ़ॉर्म रिफ्रेन्स पीरियड (URP)' डेटा पर आधारित था। यह एक ऐसी पद्धति थी जिसमें खपत व्यय का आकलन '30 दिनों की एक समान अवधि' के आधार पर किया जाता था। इसका उद्देश्य गरीबी के स्तर को मापने के लिए एक मानकीकृत समय अवधि का उपयोग करना था। बाद में, इसे 'मिक्स्ड रिफ्रेन्स पीरियड (MRP)' और फिर 'मोडिफाइड मिक्स्ड रिफ्रेन्स पीरियड (MMRP)' में बदल दिया गया, जिसमें अलग-अलग वस्तुओं के लिए अलग-अलग संदर्भ अवधियों का उपयोग किया जाता है। URP का उपयोग गरीबी के आकलन में 'समय-संगतता' और 'तुलनात्मकता' सुनिश्चित करने के लिए किया गया था।

Extra Facts:
गरीबी रेखा का आकलन करने के लिए भारत में विभिन्न समितियों ने अलग-अलग मापदंड सुझाए हैं, जैसे 'तेंदुलकर समिति' और 'रंगराजन समिति'। URP के अलावा, 'MRP' (मिक्स्ड रिफ्रेन्स पीरियड) में 365 दिनों की अवधि का उपयोग किया जाता है। गरीबी रेखा का निर्धारण 'कैलोरी खपत' और 'आवश्यक वस्तुओं की उपलब्धता' के आधार पर किया जाता है। यह आर्थिक नियोजन और सामाजिक कल्याण योजनाओं के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण संकेतक है।

question:
Consider the following statements about unemployment in India:
Seasonal unemployment is mainly found in urban areas.
Educated unemployed people are mainly found in rural areas of India.
Higher cropping intensity is desirable for reducing unemployment in the rural
economy.
Which of the given statements is/are correct?

[SSC CGL 2023]
options: Only c
Only b and c
Only a and b
Only a
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Only c

Explanation:
Seasonal unemployment is primarily found in rural areas, where agricultural activities are dependent on seasons. It is less common in urban areas. Educated unemployment is mainly observed in urban areas, as rural regions have fewer employment opportunities for educated individuals. Higher cropping intensity helps reduce unemployment in the rural economy by increasing the demand for labor in agricultural activities, thereby creating more employment opportunities.

Extra Facts:
Types of unemployment include structural unemployment, cyclical unemployment, and disguised unemployment. In India, disguised unemployment is more prevalent in rural areas, where people appear to be employed but their productivity is zero. The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) is a significant scheme aimed at reducing rural unemployment.

शिक्षित बेरोजगार लोग मुख्य रूप से भारत के ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में पाए जाते हैं।

केवल b और c
केवल a और b
केवल a
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है केवल c

Explanation:
मौसमी बेरोजगारी मुख्यतः ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में पायी जाती है, जहाँ कृषि कार्य मौसम पर निर्भर होता है। शहरी क्षेत्रों में यह कम देखने को मिलती है। शिक्षित बेरोजगारी मुख्य रूप से शहरी क्षेत्रों में पायी जाती है, क्योंकि ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में शिक्षित लोगों के लिए रोजगार के अवसर कम होते हैं। उच्च फसल सघनता ग्रामीण अर्थव्यवस्था में बेरोजगारी को कम करने में मदद करती है, क्योंकि इससे कृषि कार्यों में अधिक श्रम की मांग होती है और रोजगार के अवसर बढ़ते हैं।

Extra Facts:
बेरोजगारी के प्रकारों में ढांचागत बेरोजगारी, चक्रीय बेरोजगारी, और प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी शामिल हैं। भारत में प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में अधिक देखने को मिलती है, जहाँ लोगों के पास काम तो होता है, पर उनकी उत्पादकता शून्य होती है। महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (MGNREGA) ग्रामीण बेरोजगारी को कम करने के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण योजना है।

question:
Identify the primary characteristic of the Cooperative Development Foundation (CDF) model of SHGs regarding its focus on membership from the following.

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: It exclusively targets poor members.
It excludes women from membership.
It includes both poor and non-poor members.
It exclusively targets non-poor members.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "It includes both poor and non-poor members."

Explanation:
The primary characteristic of the Cooperative Development Foundation (CDF) model is that it includes both poor and non-poor members. This model promotes inclusive development and brings together diverse groups for socio-economic empowerment. The CDF model aims to provide financial services to all sections of the community, rather than targeting only the poor or the rich. This approach is based on the principles of cooperation, where participation of all is crucial for collective benefit.

Extra Facts:
The CDF model operates through cooperative societies and provides members with access to savings, loans, and other financial services. This model can be implemented in both rural and urban areas. An important aspect of the CDF model is that it promotes social cohesion and helps reduce economic inequality. Additionally, this model encourages the use of local resources and enhances accountability among members.

सहकारी विकास फाउंडेशन (CDF) मॉडल की प्राथमिक विशेषता यह है कि यह निर्धन और निर्धनेतर दोनों प्रकार के सदस्यों को शामिल करता है। यह मॉडल समावेशी विकास को बढ़ावा देता है और सामाजिक-आर्थिक सशक्तिकरण के लिए विविध समूहों को एक साथ लाता है। CDF मॉडल का उद्देश्य समुदाय के सभी वर्गों को वित्तीय सेवाएं प्रदान करना है, न कि केवल गरीबों या अमीरों को लक्षित करना। यह दृष्टिकोण सहकारिता के सिद्धांतों पर आधारित है, जहां सामूहिक लाभ के लिए सभी की भागीदारी महत्वपूर्ण है।

question:
The poverty ratio has declined to ______ in 2011-12 in rural India.

[SSC CGL 2022]
options:
20.9 percent

30.9 percent

25.9 percent

35.9 percent
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 25.9 percent

Explanation:
In 2011-12, India witnessed a significant decline in the poverty ratio. The poverty ratio in rural India was 25.9%, a sharp drop from 41.8% in 2004-05. This decline was due to economic growth, government schemes (like MGNREGA), and increased agricultural productivity. The poverty ratio is calculated using the Tendulkar Committee methodology, which considers calorie intake and other necessities. This figure reflects India's inclusive growth.

Extra Facts:
Different committees in India have suggested various criteria for calculating the poverty line. The Rangarajan Committee (2014) defined those spending ₹32 per day in rural areas and ₹47 in urban areas as poor. The main reasons for poverty reduction include economic reforms, social welfare schemes, and increased employment opportunities. However, poverty remains a major challenge in India.

question:
_______ , also known as search unemployment, occurs when workers lose their current job and are in the process of finding another one.

[SSC CHSL 2022]
options: Voluntary unemployment
Disguised unemployment
Frictional unemployment
Classical unemployment
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Frictional unemployment

Explanation:
Frictional unemployment is a temporary form of unemployment that occurs when workers leave their current jobs or lose them and are in the process of searching for new employment. It is also known as 'search unemployment.' This type of unemployment is a natural part of the labor market because information flow between jobs and workers is imperfect, and finding a new job takes time. Frictional unemployment persists even in a full-employment economy and is generally short-term.

Extra Facts:
Governments often reduce frictional unemployment by providing job portals, skill development programs, and employment assistance. Unlike cyclical unemployment (caused by economic downturns) or structural unemployment (due to technological changes or industry decline), frictional unemployment is not harmful to the economy. It indicates labor market dynamism as workers transition between jobs for better opportunities.

Explanation:
प्रतिरोधात्मक बेरोजगारी (Frictional unemployment) एक प्रकार की अस्थायी बेरोजगारी है जो तब होती है जब कर्मचारी अपनी वर्तमान नौकरी छोड़ देते हैं या खो देते हैं और नई नौकरी की तलाश में होते हैं। यह बेरोजगारी 'खोज बेरोजगारी' (Search unemployment) के रूप में भी जानी जाती है। यह बाजार की सामान्य प्रक्रिया का हिस्सा है क्योंकि नौकरियों और कर्मचारियों के बीच सूचना का प्रवाह पूर्ण नहीं होता और नई नौकरी खोजने में समय लगता है। यह बेरोजगारी अर्थव्यवस्था में हमेशा मौजूद रहती है, भले ही अर्थव्यवस्था पूर्ण रोजगार की स्थिति में हो।

Extra Facts:
प्रतिरोधात्मक बेरोजगारी को कम करने के लिए सरकारें रोजगार एक्सचेंज पोर्टल, कौशल विकास कार्यक्रम और नौकरी खोजने में सहायता प्रदान करती हैं। यह बेरोजगारी आमतौर पर अल्पकालिक होती है और अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए हानिकारक नहीं मानी जाती। अन्य प्रकार की बेरोजगारी जैसे 'चक्रीय बेरोजगारी' (Cyclical unemployment) मंदी के दौरान होती है, जबकि 'संरचनात्मक बेरोजगारी' (Structural unemployment) तकनीकी परिवर्तन या उद्योगों के पतन के कारण होती है।

question:
Unemployment is measured in India on the methods prescribed by the:

[SSC GD 2022]
options: National Employment Department
Reserve Bank of India
National Stock Exchange
National Sample Survey Organisation
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is National Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO)

Explanation:
In India, unemployment is measured by the methods prescribed by the National Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO). NSSO operates under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation and collects unemployment data through the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) and other surveys. The organization uses scientific sampling techniques to estimate unemployment rates across different regions and social groups in the country. NSSO's data plays a crucial role in formulating government policies and schemes.

Extra Facts:
The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) was launched in 2017 and provides quarterly and annual unemployment data. Apart from NSSO, the Central Statistics Office (CSO) also collects economic data, but NSSO is the primary agency for unemployment measurement. In India, unemployment is calculated based on the Current Daily Status (CDS) and Current Weekly Status (CWS).

question:
A microfinance loan is defined as a collateral-free loan given to a household having annual household income up to Rs. ______.

[SSC GD 2022]
options: 500000
300000
400000
600000
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 300000

Explanation:
A microfinance loan is a type of collateral-free loan provided to poor and low-income households. In India, as per RBI guidelines, this loan is given to households with an annual income of up to ₹3,00,000. These loans are used for small businesses, agricultural activities, and other income-generating activities. Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) and banks provide these loans to promote socio-economic development. Such loans play a crucial role in self-employment and poverty alleviation.

Extra Facts:
The primary objective of microfinance is to promote financial inclusion. These loans are particularly popular among women and rural populations. RBI has also established transparency and customer protection rules for MFIs. The interest rates on microfinance loans are higher than regular bank loans due to the higher risk involved. These loans often operate on a group lending model, where multiple individuals collectively borrow and repay the loan.

☛ Who is eligible for a microfinance loan? → Low-income households
☛ What is the main objective of microfinance loans? → Financial inclusion
☛ Is collateral required for microfinance loans? → No
☛ Which institution regulates microfinance loans? → RBI

question:
According to the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, What was the percentage of population living below the poverty line in Chhattisgarh in the year 2004-05?

[SSC CHSL 2023]
options:
35.9%

40.9%

32%

49%
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 49%

Explanation:
According to the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, the percentage of the population living below the poverty line in Chhattisgarh in 2004-05 was 49%. This data is based on the Tendulkar Committee methodology, which used consumption expenditure as the criterion for poverty estimation. States like Chhattisgarh had higher poverty rates due to a large tribal and rural population. During this period, India's national poverty rate was around 37.2%, making Chhattisgarh's situation worse in comparison.

Extra Facts:
- The Tendulkar Committee (2009) defined the poverty line as ₹860/month (urban) and ₹672/month (rural).
- By 2011-12, Chhattisgarh's poverty rate reduced to 39.93%, reflecting progress under Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
- NITI Aayog adopted the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), which measures deprivation in education, health, and living standards.

question:
If labour is employed in a job but is not actually utilised for the production of goods and services, it is known as:

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: seasonal unemployment
educated unemployment
disguised unemployment
urban unemployment
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is disguised unemployment

Explanation:
Disguised unemployment occurs when workers are employed but their marginal productivity is zero or negligible. This is commonly observed in the agricultural sector, where more workers are engaged than needed, and removing some does not affect total output. It reflects 'hidden unemployment' where labour is not effectively utilised. This indicates inefficiency in resource allocation in the economy.

Extra Facts:
Disguised unemployment is a major issue in developing countries, especially in rural areas. It represents a 'surplus labour' situation where marginal productivity of labour is zero. Solutions include industrialisation and labour reallocation to other sectors. In India, schemes like MNREGA aim to address this problem by providing alternative employment opportunities.

☛ Which type of unemployment does not affect output when workers are removed? → Disguised unemployment
☛ Excess labour in agriculture is called? → Disguised unemployment
☛ MNREGA aims to reduce which type of unemployment? → Disguised unemployment
☛ Most common unemployment type in developing countries? → Disguised unemployment

प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी तब होती है जब श्रमिकों को कार्य में लगाया जाता है, लेकिन उनकी उत्पादकता शून्य या नगण्य होती है। यह अक्सर कृषि क्षेत्र में देखा जाता है, जहाँ अधिक श्रमिक लगे होते हैं, लेकिन उनमें से कुछ को हटा देने पर भी कुल उत्पादन पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता। यह 'छिपी हुई बेरोजगारी' का एक रूप है, जहाँ श्रम का वास्तविक उपयोग नहीं होता। यह अर्थव्यवस्था में संसाधनों की अकुशलता को दर्शाता है।

प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी विकासशील देशों में एक प्रमुख समस्या है, विशेषकर ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में। यह 'अधिश्रम' (surplus labour) की स्थिति को दर्शाता है, जहाँ श्रम की सीमांत उत्पादकता शून्य होती है। इस समस्या का समाधान औद्योगीकरण और श्रम का अन्य क्षेत्रों में स्थानांतरण है। भारत में यह समस्या गहरी है, जिसके लिए MNREGA जैसी योजनाएँ लागू की गई हैं।
